title: My 10K AI Side Hustle Journey
full_monologue: **I built a $10K side hustle using only AI tools.** It started with voice-to-text, then AI content creation, and finally automated sales. I used AI to write copy, design graphics, and even handle customer service. The key was finding a niche and scaling fast. I didn’t need a website or a team—just the right tools. If I can do it, you can too. What’s your AI side hustle idea?
